variables.toolTip:
Toggles if this container will be used to draw the painted cloud coverage when UDS queries the level for containers. If two are present that are both active, only one will be used.
At runtime, use the Activate and Deactivate functions to turn this on and off.

metaData.tooltip:
Toggles if this container will be used to draw the painted cloud coverage when UDS queries the level for containers. If two are present that are both active, only one will be used.
At runtime, use the Activate and Deactivate functions to turn this on and off.

variables.toolTip: Textures of painted cloud coverage, each associated with a cell X and Y coordinate. This should typically not be edited manually. This is intended to be managed by the Volumetric Cloud Painter, found in the Blueprints folder.
